items.title: Stripe 以 75 億美元收購 OpenRouter，AI 模型路由成核心基礎設施
items.title_en: Stripe Acquires OpenRouter for $7.5B, Making AI Token Routing Core Infrastructure
items.summary: Stripe 以 75 億美元收購 AI 模型路由平台 OpenRouter，較三個月前估值溢價近 6 倍，坐穩 AI 時代開發者支付及模型費用管理核心位置。
items.summary_en: Stripe confirmed acquiring OpenRouter for $7.5B — nearly 6x its valuation three months prior — positioning itself at the center of AI developer spending and model cost management.
items.why: AI 工具採購成企業主要開支，品牌需理解模型路由平台如何影響 AI 預算分配。
items.why_en: AI tool spend is a major enterprise budget line; brands must understand how routing platforms shape their AI cost allocation.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI 推出零數據保留安全監控，直接狙擊 Anthropic 企業策略
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Zero-Retention Safety Monitoring to Counter Anthropic's Data Policy
items.summary: OpenAI 推出跨會話安全監控，在零數據保留前提下偵測濫用，直接回應 Anthropic Fable 模型 30 日數據保留政策引發的企業客戶憂慮。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launched cross-session safety monitoring with zero data retention, countering backlash over Anthropic's 30-day retention policy for enterprise Fable-class models.
items.why: 企業客戶對數據私隱敏感，此競爭動態影響品牌選用 AI 供應商的決策。
items.why_en: Enterprise data privacy is decisive in AI vendor selection — this competitive shift directly affects agency procurement decisions.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Ramp 數據：Anthropic 企業市佔 44% 領先，OpenAI 追勢更急
items.title_en: Ramp Data: Anthropic Leads Enterprise at 44% but OpenAI Growing Faster in Q3
items.summary: 追蹤 7 萬家美國企業的 Ramp 數據顯示 Anthropic 企業市佔 44%、OpenAI 40%，而 Q3 2026 OpenAI 增速更快，料由 GPT-5.6 Sol 推出帶動。
items.summary_en: Ramp's 70,000+ U.S. business dataset shows Anthropic at 44% vs OpenAI's 40% enterprise share, but OpenAI is growing faster in Q3 2026 driven by GPT-5.6 Sol.
items.why: AI 市場份額快速變動，marketer 需跟進主流工具更替，確保採用最具效益的供應商。
items.why_en: Enterprise AI market share is volatile — marketers must track vendor shifts to stay on the most cost-effective platform.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Pew 研究：ChatGPT 推出後三成五新網頁具 AI 寫作特徵
items.title_en: Pew Research: 35% of Web Pages Published After ChatGPT Show AI Authorship Signs
items.summary: Pew Research 分析 50 萬個英語網頁，ChatGPT 推出後發佈的網頁 35% 具明顯 AI 創作特徵，.com 域名 AI 內容比例是 .edu/.gov 的10 倍。
items.summary_en: Pew analyzed 500,000 English web pages: 35% of post-ChatGPT pages show significant AI authorship signs, with .com domains showing ~10x more AI content than .edu/.gov.
items.why: AI 內容泛濫令品牌原創聲音更具競爭優勢，需重新評估人味內容策略。
items.why_en: AI content saturation makes authentic brand voice a competitive differentiator — rethink your human-authored content strategy.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Grok 出現亂碼故障，xAI 同期大量研究員離職
items.title_en: Grok Sends Gibberish Responses as ~50 xAI Researchers Depart
items.summary: Grok.com 出現輸出亂碼故障，同期 xAI 約 50 名研究員及工程師相繼離職，外界對 xAI 模型穩定性及研發能力產生質疑。
items.summary_en: Grok.com generated nonsensical responses, coinciding with reports of ~50 xAI researchers and engineers departing, raising serious doubts about the platform's reliability.
items.why: 企業選用 AI 工具時穩定性至關重要，xAI 的技術及人才問題提示其 B2B 供應商風險。
items.why_en: Stability is critical for enterprise AI tools — xAI's technical and talent issues are a red flag for B2B reliance on Grok.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Anthropic Claude 自主設計蛋白質，成功率超越人類研究員基準
items.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Autonomously Designs Proteins at 35% Hit Rate, Beating Human Baseline
items.summary: Anthropic 研究顯示 Claude 針對 14/15 個目標設計出蛋白質結合物，成功率 22-35%，優於人類研究員 10-15% 基準，部分設計破親和力紀錄。
items.summary_en: Anthropic research shows Claude designed protein binders for 14/15 targets at 22–35% hit rates vs the 10–15% human baseline, with some designs exceeding published affinity records.
items.why: AI 在科研領域突破人類基準，預示各行業研發轉型，agency 應早著先機。
items.why_en: AI surpassing human benchmarks in science signals broader professional disruption — agencies should anticipate evolving client needs in specialized domains.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI 廣告業務擴展至 31 個歐洲市場，每週活躍用戶達十億
items.title_en: OpenAI Expands Ad Business to 31 European Markets as ChatGPT Hits 1B Weekly Users
items.summary: OpenAI 宣佈廣告試點擴展至德法西等 31 個歐洲市場，ChatGPT 每週活躍用戶達十億，其中兩成具購買意圖，廣告收入自 8 月初增長逾 25%。
items.summary_en: OpenAI expanded its ad pilot to 31 European markets. ChatGPT hits 1 billion weekly active users with ~20% commercial intent. Ad revenue grew 25%+ since early August.
items.why: ChatGPT 用戶規模同購買意圖顯示其廣告潛力，MarTech 預算規劃需納入 LLM 平台。
items.why_en: ChatGPT's billion-user scale and high commercial intent signal a major emerging ad channel to factor into 2027 media planning.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: OpenAI 以 GDPR 同意框架進軍歐洲，ChatGPT 雙層廣告制度落地
items.title_en: OpenAI Uses GDPR Consent Framework for EU ChatGPT Ads: Two-Tier System Launches
items.summary: OpenAI 在 GDPR 框架下取得用戶同意：同意者獲個人化廣告，拒絕者仍見情境廣告，雙層制方案或催生付費升級壓力。
items.summary_en: OpenAI proactively seeks GDPR consent for personalized ads. Consenting users get full targeting; non-consenters see contextual-only ads. Privacy experts flag potential paid upgrade pressure.
items.why: 廣告主應關注 ChatGPT 歐洲用戶同意率，評估個人化定向效果再規劃預算。
items.why_en: Advertisers should monitor EU consent rates to gauge targeting effectiveness before committing budget to this new ChatGPT channel.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Meta AI 新增廣告分析工具：對話式查詢廣告表現
items.title_en: Meta AI Adds Conversational Ad Analysis Tools for Campaign Optimisation
items.summary: Meta AI 直接連結廣告帳戶，廣告主可對話查詢高效受眾、找出表現差廣告並生成報告；可整合 Google Workspace，初期免費，大量使用須升級 Meta One。
items.summary_en: Meta AI now connects to ad accounts for conversational audience analysis, creative performance insights, and automated reports. Google Workspace integration available; heavy use requires Meta One subscription.
items.why: 廣告主可用對話式 AI 替代傳統報告流程，降低數據分析門檻同時間成本。
items.why_en: SMB advertisers can replace manual reporting with conversational AI analysis — lower skill barrier, faster optimization cycles.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google AI Max 新增多廣告系列 A/B 測試及 Performance Planner 升級
items.title_en: Google AI Max Gets Multi-Campaign A/B Testing and Upgraded Performance Planner
items.summary: Google AI Max 搜尋廣告新增多廣告系列 A/B 測試、品牌與地點控制實驗，及強化版 Performance Planner，幫助廣告主更安心擴大 AI 廣告投入。
items.summary_en: Google AI Max search campaigns now include multi-campaign A/B testing, brand and location control experiments, and an upgraded Performance Planner to help advertisers scale AI-driven campaigns with confidence.
items.why: 可即時測試 AI Max 對廣告成效的影響，數據支撐決策，降低擴大預算的風險。
items.why_en: Advertisers can now test AI Max impact with data before scaling budgets, reducing risk when committing to AI-driven campaigns.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: AI 代理廣告量測陷困局：無點擊漏斗、歸因框架未成形
items.title_en: Advertising to AI Agents Has a Measurement Problem: No Clicks, No Attribution Framework
items.summary: 出版商向 AI 代理投放廣告但缺乏歸因機制：無點擊漏斗、多來源合成答案令廣告效果無從追蹤，IAB 框架尚未定案。
items.summary_en: As publishers target AI agents with ads, attribution is broken: no click equivalent, multi-source synthesis makes crediting any single placement nearly impossible. IAB framework not yet finalized.
items.why: 廣告主需暫緩大規模投放 AI 代理廣告，先等業界量測標準成形，避免浪費預算。
items.why_en: Hold off scaling AI-agent ad spend until measurement standards emerge — current ROAS tracking is unreliable and risks wasted budgets.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google Flow 整合 Veo 3.1 一站式 AI 廣告製作，免費版每日 50 積分
items.title_en: Google Flow Integrates Veo 3.1 for End-to-End AI Ad Production, Free Tier Offers 50 Daily Credits
items.summary: Google Flow 整合 Gemini Omni 及 Veo 3.1，提供從策劃到精修的一站式 AI 廣告製作流程，創作人成功為小企業製作高質素廣告片，免費版提供每日 50 積分。
items.summary_en: Google Flow combines Gemini Omni and Veo 3.1 for end-to-end AI creative production. Industry creators produced studio-quality campaigns for SMBs, with a free tier offering 50 daily credits.
items.why: 中小企業可低成本製作專業廣告影片，縮短製作週期，直接改變廣告素材策略。
items.why_en: SMEs can now produce professional ad videos at significantly lower cost, shortening production cycles and reshaping creative strategy.

items.title: YouTube 大幅升級 CTV 體驗，播放清單可轉為連集節目
items.title_en: YouTube Rolls Out Major CTV Improvements, Playlists Can Now Become Episodic Shows
items.summary: YouTube 創作者可將播放清單轉為連集節目，新增節目與播客分頁，平台每日 CTV 觀看超過十億小時。
items.summary_en: YouTube creators can now convert playlists into episodic shows with dedicated pages. New show and podcast tabs launched, with over 1 billion CTV viewing hours daily.
items.why: 廣告主應將 CTV 納入媒體主力渠道，連集格式可提升廣告環境及觀眾黏著度。
items.why_en: Advertisers should prioritize CTV in media plans; episodic content formats improve ad environment quality and audience retention.

items.title: 品牌商對 AI 媒購代理持保留態度：先整頓供應鏈再自動化
items.title_en: 'Waste in the System': Why Georgia-Pacific Is Holding Out on AI Buying Agents
items.summary: Georgia-Pacific 高管指出 AI 媒購代理只會將現有浪費自動化。該品牌花兩年整頓 SSP 供應鏈，待質量達標才考慮引入代理系統，業界代理採購標準至今未確立。
items.summary_en: Georgia-Pacific's senior director argues AI buying agents automate waste, not fix it. The brand spent two years cleaning its supply chain before considering agent deployment. No industry standards yet govern agent-to-agent buying.
items.why: 品牌主在採用 AI 媒購前須先審視數據質量與供應鏈健康度，否則只會加速浪費。
items.why_en: Brands must audit supply chain quality before deploying buying agents — garbage in, garbage out at automated speed.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 可口可樂用 AI「Project Fizzion」統一管理全球 200 市場品牌設計
items.title_en: Coca-Cola Uses AI System 'Project Fizzion' to Manage Brand Design Across 200 Markets
items.summary: 可口可樂聯同 Adobe 開發 Project Fizzion，將靜態 PDF 品牌指引轉化為動態數碼 StyleIDs，實現跨 200 個市場的品牌設計自動化一致性管理。
items.summary_en: Coca-Cola partnered with Adobe on Project Fizzion, converting static PDF brand guidelines into dynamic digital StyleIDs for AI-managed brand design consistency across 200 global markets.
items.why: 企業級 AI 品牌管理成趨勢，大型廣告主應評估以 AI 替代人工品牌審核流程。
items.why_en: A bellwether case for enterprise AI brand governance — large advertisers should evaluate AI-managed design systems to replace manual brand review.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Binance 推出 Agent OS，AI 可自主執行加密貨幣交易但風控靠用戶
items.title_en: Binance Launches Agent OS Letting AI Agents Trade Crypto Autonomously
items.summary: Binance 推出 Agent OS 平台，支援 ChatGPT、Claude Code 等 AI 自主執行加密貨幣交易，平台無法監控 Agent 決策邏輯，風險管控完全由用戶負責。
items.summary_en: Binance launched Agent OS enabling AI agents like ChatGPT and Claude Code to autonomously execute crypto trades. Binance cannot monitor agent reasoning — risk control falls entirely on users.
items.why: AI Agent 進入金融執行層是重大趨勢，marketer 需理解自主 AI 的監管風險與邊界。
items.why_en: AI agents entering financial execution signals a major expansion of autonomous AI scope — marketers need to understand emerging regulatory risks.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: AI 修不好你的訊號架構，只會把缺陷放大
items.title_en: AI Won't Fix Your Signal Architecture – It Will Amplify Its Flaws
items.summary: Gartner 預測 AI 代理將於 2028 年介入 15 兆美元 B2B 採購。文章警告代理無法辨別訊號質量，壞假設會全速複製到所有帳戶，第一方數據架構才是核心競爭壁壘。
items.summary_en: Gartner projects AI agents will mediate $15T in B2B purchases by 2028. Warning: agents optimize blindly, replicating bad assumptions at full speed. First-party signal architecture quality is the next competitive moat.
items.why: MarTech 團隊須優先整頓第一方數據質量與訊號層級，否則 AI 只會加速錯誤決策。
items.why_en: Martech teams must prioritize first-party data quality and signal hierarchy now — AI automation amplifies data flaws at full speed.

items.title: 80% 帶 AI 摘要的 Google 搜尋在無點擊下結束
items.title_en: 80% of Google Searches with AI Summaries End Without a Single Click
items.summary: 研究顯示帶有 AI 生成摘要的 Google 搜尋中 80% 用戶不點擊任何連結，傳統 SEO 排名對流量的影響正在瓦解，內容需讓 AI 可讀取。
items.summary_en: Research finds 80% of Google searches with AI summaries end without any click. Traditional SEO rankings are decoupled from traffic; producing machine-readable content is now critical for product discovery.
items.why: SEO 策略需轉型：確保內容被 AI 摘要採用，比追排名帶來的點擊流量更重要。
items.why_en: SEO strategy must pivot — optimize for AI summary inclusion over click-rank, or face invisible traffic losses.

items.title: 81% 行銷人認為高層 AI 技能最弱，CMO 成最大短板
items.title_en: 81% of Marketers Say Senior Leaders Are Least AI-Proficient, CMOs Are the Biggest Gap
items.summary: NewtonX 與 AdWeek 調查 500 位行銷人，47% 認為高層落後所有職級；Gartner 指僅 15% CEO 認為 CMO 具備足夠 AI 技能，形成由上而下的技能鴻溝。
items.summary_en: A NewtonX/AdWeek survey of 500 marketers found 47% believe senior leadership lags all other levels in AI skills. Gartner data shows only 15% of CEOs feel their CMO has sufficient AI capabilities.
items.why: CMO 若不主動提升 AI 認知，將失去對數位廣告策略的話語權，影響業務競爭力。
items.why_en: CMOs who don't upskill on AI risk losing strategic authority over digital advertising — undermining overall business competitiveness.
